title: Command palette opened with Ctrl K
when: The user wants a keyboard driven palette that searches commands and pages and runs the chosen one.
inputs: the commands with labels and actions
prompt:
Goal: A modal palette that opens with Ctrl+K or Meta+K, filters commands as you type and runs one with Enter.
Steps:
1. <dialog aria-label="Command palette"> with a labeled <input role="combobox" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="cmd-list"> and <ul id="cmd-list" role="listbox">.
2. Commands come from one array of { id, label, group, keywords, run }; render options with createElement and textContent.
3. Open on keydown when (ctrlKey or metaKey) and key is k, with preventDefault; also offer a visible button.
4. Match when every query word prefixes a word of the label or keywords; rank label starts first; group with role="group" and aria-label.
5. Arrow keys move aria-activedescendant; Enter runs the command and closes; Escape closes natively.
6. Show recent commands when the query is empty and the result count in role="status".
Quality bar:
- Opens in under 100 ms with focus in the input.
- Each option shows its shortcut if it has one.
- Up to about 50 results, scrolling.
Pitfalls:
- Stealing Ctrl+K while the user types in a text field that uses it.
- Real focus moving into the list.
- Commands that run twice on a held Enter.
Verify:
- [ ] The dialog has a name and a Close button.
- [ ] The input has a label.
- [ ] Ctrl+K and Meta+K open it.
- [ ] The count is announced.
Output: Dialog markup, palette.css and palette.js with the commands array.

examples.input: paleta de comandos com ctrl k no meu app
examples.output: dialog with combobox input, grouped options Pages and Actions, prefix matching, Enter runs, recent commands first
